title: Scandinavian/Nordic
content: Apply Scandinavian/Nordic design with clean, warm minimalism. Use muted, natural color palette: warm whites (bg-stone-50), soft grays, pale blues, dusty pinks, forest green. Simple geometric shapes and clean lines. Natural materials aesthetic: wood textures, linen patterns. Generous whitespace and breathing room. Rounded but not overly soft corners (rounded-lg). Simple, functional typography - clean sans-serif. Include nature-inspired subtle patterns. Create hygge (cozy) atmosphere with warm tones.

variants.simple: Create clean, minimal Nordic design with natural colors, simple shapes, and cozy warmth.
variants.detailed: Apply Scandinavian/Nordic design with clean, warm minimalism. Use muted, natural color palette: warm whites (bg-stone-50), soft grays, pale blues, dusty pinks, forest green. Simple geometric shapes and clean lines. Natural materials aesthetic: wood textures, linen patterns. Generous whitespace and breathing room. Rounded but not overly soft corners (rounded-lg). variants.advanced: Apply Scandinavian/Nordic design philosophy with clean, warm minimalism and functional beauty. Color palette: warm whites and creams (stone-50, orange-50/30), soft grays (gray-200 to gray-400), muted accents - dusty pink (rose-200), pale blue (sky-200), sage green (green-300), mustard (amber-300). Natural material textures: subtle wood grain patterns for cards/backgrounds, linen texture overlays, natural paper feel. Whitespace: generous padding (py-16, px-8), large gaps (gap-8), content breathing room. Shape language: clean geometric, slightly rounded corners (rounded-lg), avoid both sharp and overly bubbly. Typography: clean, humanist sans-serif (Inter, Nunito Sans, Open Sans), moderate weights, comfortable line-height. Functional design: every element serves purpose, no decoration without function. Furniture-inspired: cards and containers with subtle shadows suggesting physical objects. Nature motifs: simple line illustrations of plants, mountains, abstract natural shapes. Hygge warmth: warm lighting feel through subtle amber/cream tints, comfortable not stark. Grid: structured but not rigid, asymmetric balance. Icons: simple, rounded strokes, nature-inspired. Photography style: bright, airy, natural light, lifestyle imagery. Sustainability visual cues: recycled textures, natural dyes, handcraft elements. Accessibility: high contrast from neutral palette, clear functional design aids usability.
